column1: # Security webapps for Oniomarchy's Security > Webapps menu.
# id_slug   - reserved for the future security.webapps.<id_slug> jsonc id
#             once menu.sh is extended to read this file (not built yet —
# label     - passed as-is to `omarchy webapp install <label> <url> <icon>`
#             — becomes both the .desktop filename and its Name= (and
# tactic    - which tactic category (same ids as categories.tsv) this
#             webapp maps to — doc-reference only, does NOT place it in
#             that category's submenu. See "Decision: Webapps get their
#             own menu" in notes/pentest-tools.md for why they're grouped
#             together under security.webapps instead of scattered by
#             tactic like everything in categories.tsv is.
#             passes an empty 3rd arg, which triggers
#             -> well-known path -> Google favicon proxy). Any other value
#             is passed straight through as ICON_REF (a URL, a local file
#             path, or a bundled/system icon theme name) — used when a
#             site has no auto-fetchable icon at all. See "Gaps" note in
#             notes/pentest-tools.md for why osint-framework needs one.
# Kept in sync with notes/pentest-tools.md's "Webapps" table by hand.
